Data model (shared for contact/quote)

ts
export interface QuoteRequest {
  name: string;
  phone: string;
  email: string;
  location: string;
  cleaningType: 'Regular' | 'Deep' | 'Move-in/out' | 'Once-off';
  message: string;
  source?: 'Website';
}

Angular template (form section)

html
<form [formGroup]="quoteForm" (ngSubmit)="submit()">
  <input formControlName="name" placeholder="Name" />
  <input formControlName="phone" placeholder="Phone" />
  <input formControlName="email" placeholder="Email" />
  <input formControlName="location" placeholder="Location (Suburb & City)" />

  <select formControlName="cleaningType">
    <option value="Regular">Regular Cleaning</option>
    <option value="Deep">Deep Cleaning</option>
    <option value="Move-in/out">Move-in / Move-out</option>
    <option value="Once-off">Once-off Cleaning</option>
  </select>

  <textarea formControlName="message" placeholder="Message"></textarea>

  <button type="submit" [disabled]="quoteForm.invalid || loading">
    {{ loading ? 'Sending...' : 'Send Request' }}
  </button>

  <p *ngIf="success">Thanks! We’ve received your request and will respond shortly.</p>
  <p *ngIf="error">Sorry—something went wrong. Please WhatsApp us instead.</p>
</form>

Angular service (POST request)

ts
submitQuote(payload: QuoteRequest) {
  return this.http.post('/api/quotes', payload);
}

Backend fields to store (minimum)

  • name, phone, email, location, cleaningType, message

  • createdAt, status (New/In Progress/Quoted/Booked)

  • preferredDate (optional enhancement)

3) Global CSS (ONE “system” injected everywhere)

Put this in: src/styles.css

✅ This is your global theme that every component uses via classes.

css
/* =========================
   GLOBAL THEME SYSTEM
   ========================= */

:root{
  --bg-dark: #050b14;
  --bg-dark-2:#0b1220;
  --cyan: #00c2ff;
  --cyan-soft:#6fe8ff;

  --white:#ffffff;
  --text-dark:#0b0f1a;
  --muted:#6b7280;

  --border:#e7eaf3;

  --shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(2,8,23,.10);
  --shadow-2: 0 14px 40px rgba(2,8,23,.14);

  --radius-xl:22px;
  --radius-lg:16px;
  --radius-md:12px;

  --nav-h: 76px;
}

*{ box-sizing:border-box; }
html{ scroll-behavior:smooth; }
body{
  margin:0;
  font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
  background:#fff;
  color:var(--text-dark);
}

/* Layout helpers */
.ui-container{
  width:min(1200px, 92vw);
  margin-inline:auto;
}
.ui-section{
  padding: 86px 0;
}
.ui-section--tight{ padding: 70px 0; }

/* Offset so fixed nav doesn’t cover anchors */
.ui-anchor{
  scroll-margin-top: calc(var(--nav-h) + 18px);
}

/* Section title like screenshots */
.ui-section-title{ margin-bottom:36px; }
.ui-kicker{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:14px;
  color:#9aa3b2;
  font-weight:600;
  font-size: 22px;
}
.ui-kicker-line{
  height:3px; width:110px;
  background: var(--cyan);
  border-radius:999px;
}
.ui-h2{
  font-family:Poppins, Inter, system-ui;
  font-weight:800;
  font-size: clamp(32px, 3.6vw, 56px);
  letter-spacing:-.6px;
  margin: 10px 0 0;
}

/* Buttons (global) */
.ui-btn{
  border:0;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 12px 18px;
  font-weight:700;
  cursor:pointer;
  transition:.25s ease;
  text-decoration:none;
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  gap:10px;
}
.ui-btn-primary{
  background: var(--cyan);
  color:#04101d;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(0,194,255,.18);
}
.ui-btn-primary:hover{ transform: translateY(-2px); }
.ui-btn-outline{
  background: transparent;
  border:1px solid rgba(0,194,255,.45);
  color: #fff;
}
.ui-btn-outline:hover{
  border-color: var(--cyan);
  box-shadow: 0 14px 30px rgba(0,194,255,.10);
}

/* Cards */
.ui-card{
  background:#fff;
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
}
.ui-card-topline{
  border-top: 4px solid var(--cyan);
}

/* Grids */
.ui-grid-3{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 28px;
}
.ui-grid-2{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 28px;
}
@media (max-width: 1000px){
  .ui-grid-3{ grid-template-columns:1fr; }
  .ui-grid-2{ grid-template-columns:1fr; }
}

/* Floating WhatsApp */
.ui-whatsapp-float{
  position:fixed;
  right:18px;
  bottom:18px;
  z-index:999;
  background: #25D366;
  color:#03110a;
  font-weight:800;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  text-decoration:none;
  box-shadow: 0 18px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.25);
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:10px;
}
.ui-whatsapp-float:hover{ transform: translateY(-2px); transition:.2s ease; }

import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class ScrollService {
  scrollTo(id: string): void {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!el) return;
    el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
  }
}

6) Navbar (Fixed, responsive)

ts
import { Component } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { ScrollService } from '../../core/services/scroll.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-navbar',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule],
  templateUrl: './navbar.component.html',
  styleUrl: './navbar.component.css'
})
export class NavbarComponent {
  mobileOpen = false;

  constructor(private scroll: ScrollService) {}

  go(id: string) {
    this.mobileOpen = false;
    this.scroll.scrollTo(id);
  }
}

navbar.component.css

css
.nav{
  position:fixed;
  top:0; left:0; right:0;
  height: var(--nav-h);
  z-index:1000;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(5,11,20,.95), rgba(5,11,20,.90));
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
}
.nav-inner{
  height:100%;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:18px;
}

.brand{
  display:flex;
  gap:12px;
  align-items:center;
  text-decoration:none;
  cursor:pointer;
}
.brand-logo{
  width:56px; height:40px;
  border:2px solid rgba(0,194,255,.65);
  border-radius:10px;
  display:grid;
  place-items:center;
  color:var(--cyan);
  font-weight:900;
  letter-spacing:.5px;
}
.brand-text{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; line-height:1.05; }
.brand-text strong{
  font-family:Poppins;
  font-weight:800;
  font-size:14px;
  color:#fff;
}
.brand-text span{
  font-size:12px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,.65);
}

.nav-links{
  display:flex;
  gap:28px;
  align-items:center;
}
.nav-links a{
  color: var(--cyan);
  text-decoration:none;
  font-weight:500;
  position:relative;
  padding:8px 2px;
  cursor:pointer;
}
.nav-links a::after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  left:0; bottom:2px;
  width:0; height:2px;
  background:var(--cyan);
  transition:.25s ease;
}
.nav-links a:hover::after{ width:100%; }

.nav-actions{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; }
.nav-cta{
  color:#04101d;
  background: var(--cyan);
  text-decoration:none;
  font-weight:800;
  padding:10px 14px;
  border-radius: 12px;
}
.burger{
  display:none;
  width:44px;
  height:44px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  border:1px solid rgba(0,194,255,.35);
  background: transparent;
  cursor:pointer;
}
.burger span{
  display:block;
  width:18px;
  height:2px;
  background: var(--cyan);
  margin:5px auto;
}

/* Mobile */
@media (max-width: 980px){
  .nav-links{ display:none; }
  .burger{ display:inline-block; }

  .nav-links.open{
    display:flex;
    position:absolute;
    top: var(--nav-h);
    right: 4vw;
    left: 4vw;
    background: rgba(5,11,20,.98);
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 14px;
    flex-direction:column;
    gap:10px;
  }
  .nav-cta{ display:none; }
}

G) Contact (left info + right reactive form)

pages/contact/contact.component.ts

ts
import { Component } from '@angular/core';
import { ReactiveFormsModule, FormBuilder, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { SectionHeaderComponent } from '../../shared/components/section-header/section-header.component';
import { QuoteService } from '../../core/services/quote.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-contact',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, SectionHeaderComponent],
  templateUrl: './contact.component.html',
  styleUrl: './contact.component.css'
})
export class ContactComponent {
  loading = false;
  success = false;
  error = false;

  form = this.fb.group({
    name: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.minLength(2)]],
    phone: ['', [Validators.required]],
    email: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.email]],
    location: ['', [Validators.required]],
    propertyType: ['House', [Validators.required]],
    cleaningType: ['Regular', [Validators.required]],
    preferredDate: [''],
    message: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.minLength(10)]],
  });

  constructor(private fb: FormBuilder, private quoteService: QuoteService) {}

  async submit() {
    this.success = false;
    this.error = false;

    if (this.form.invalid) {
      this.form.markAllAsTouched();
      return;
    }

    try {
      this.loading = true;
      await this.quoteService.submitQuote(this.form.getRawValue() as any);
      this.success = true;
      this.form.reset({
        propertyType: 'House',
        cleaningType: 'Regular'
      });
    } catch {
      this.error = true;
    } finally {
      this.loading = false;
    }
  }

  get waText(): string {
    return encodeURIComponent(
`Hi 👋 I’d like to book a cleaning / request a quote.
Location (Suburb & City): __________
Property type: House / Apartment / Flat
Bedrooms / Bathrooms: __ / __
Cleaning type: Regular / Deep / Move-in/out / Once-off
Preferred date & time: __________
Frequency: Weekly / Bi-weekly / Monthly
Extras: oven / fridge / windows / cupboards
Thank you!`
    );
  }
}

contact.component.html

html
<section id="contact" class="ui-section ui-anchor">
  <div class="ui-container">
    <app-section-header kicker="Contact" title="CHECK OUR CONTACT-US"></app-section-header>

    <div class="contact-wrap">
      <div class="ui-card ui-card-topline info-card">
        <div class="info-item">
          <div class="info-icon">📞</div>
          <div>
            <strong>Contact Number</strong>
            <span>0XX XXX XXXX</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="info-item">
          <div class="info-icon">💬</div>
          <div>
            <strong>WhatsApp</strong>
            <a class="link"
               [href]="'https://wa.me/27XXXXXXXXX?text=' + waText"
               target="_blank" rel="noopener">Chat on WhatsApp</a>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="info-item">
          <div class="info-icon">✉️</div>
          <div>
            <strong>Email</strong>
            <span>info@yourcleaningbusiness.co.za</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="ui-card ui-card-topline form-card">
        <form [formGroup]="form" (ngSubmit)="submit()">
          <div class="form-grid">
            <div>
              <label>Your Name</label>
              <input class="input" formControlName="name" placeholder="Full name">
            </div>

            <div>
              <label>Your Email</label>
              <input class="input" formControlName="email" placeholder="you@email.com">
            </div>

            <div>
              <label>Phone</label>
              <input class="input" formControlName="phone" placeholder="07X XXX XXXX">
            </div>

            <div>
              <label>Location</label>
              <input class="input" formControlName="location" placeholder="Suburb & City">
            </div>

            <div>
              <label>Property Type</label>
              <select class="select" formControlName="propertyType">
                <option>House</option>
                <option>Apartment</option>
                <option>Flat</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label>Type of Cleaning</label>
              <select class="select" formControlName="cleaningType">
                <option>Regular</option>
                <option>Deep</option>
                <option>Move-in/out</option>
                <option>Once-off</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            <div style="grid-column: 1 / -1;">
              <label>Preferred Date (optional)</label>
              <input class="input" formControlName="preferredDate" type="date">
            </div>

            <div style="grid-column: 1 / -1;">
              <label>Message</label>
              <textarea class="textarea" formControlName="message" placeholder="Tell us about your home and what you need..."></textarea>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="form-actions">
            <button class="ui-btn ui-btn-primary" type="submit" [disabled]="loading">
              {{ loading ? 'Sending...' : 'Send Request' }}
            </button>
            <a class="ui-btn" style="background:#111827;color:#fff"
               [href]="'https://wa.me/27XXXXXXXXX?text=' + waText"
               target="_blank" rel="noopener">WhatsApp Instead</a>
          </div>

          <p class="msg ok" *ngIf="success">Thanks! We’ve received your request and will respond shortly.</p>
          <p class="msg err" *ngIf="error">Sorry—something went wrong. Please WhatsApp us instead.</p>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

ChatGPT said:

That error means AppComponent is trying to import (in its imports: [...]) one or more components that are not declared as standalone: true. You can fix it either by:

A — making the child components standalone, or
B — keeping them as NgModule-declared components and referencing them via an NgModule (the classic approach).

Because you earlier wanted a standalone setup, I'll show the simplest fix: convert the components to standalone components (example: Navbar) and then import them into the standalone AppComponent. I’ll also show the alternative in case you prefer the NgModule approach.

Option 1 — Convert the component(s) to standalone (recommended if you want a standalone root)

1) Edit the component (example: NavbarComponent)

Open src/app/layout/navbar/navbar.component.ts and change the @Component decorator to include standalone: true and required imports (usually CommonModule):

ts
// src/app/layout/navbar/navbar.component.ts
import { Component } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { ScrollService } from '../../core/services/scroll.service'; // if you use it

@Component({
  selector: 'app-navbar',
  standalone: true,                // <--- add this
  imports: [CommonModule],          // <--- any modules/pipes/directives you use in template
  templateUrl: './navbar.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./navbar.component.css']
})
export class NavbarComponent {
  mobileOpen = false;

  constructor(private scroll: ScrollService) {}

  go(id: string) {
    this.mobileOpen = false;
    this.scroll.scrollTo(id);
  }
}

Notes:

  • Add imports: [CommonModule] so template features like ngIf, ngFor, etc. work.

  • If the template also uses ReactiveFormsModule or other standalone directives, include them in imports too.

2) Repeat for every other component you import into AppComponent

Every component you list inside AppComponent's imports: [...] must be standalone. So update these files similarly:

  • src/app/pages/home/home.component.ts

  • src/app/pages/about/about.component.ts

  • src/app/pages/services/services.component.ts

  • src/app/pages/team/team.component.ts

  • src/app/pages/portfolio/portfolio.component.ts

  • src/app/pages/pricing/pricing.component.ts

  • src/app/pages/contact/contact.component.ts

  • Any shared components used directly by AppComponent (e.g., SectionHeaderComponent) must be standalone too.

Example (home component minimal change):

ts
// src/app/pages/home/home.component.ts
import { Component } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-home',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule],
  templateUrl: './home.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./home.component.css']
})
export class HomeComponent { }

If a component uses other standalone components (for example app-section-header), include them in the imports array:

ts
imports: [CommonModule, SectionHeaderComponent]

3) Update app.component.ts to import the now-standalone components

Example src/app/app.component.ts (standalone root):

ts
// src/app/app.component.ts
import { Component } from '@angular/core';

import { NavbarComponent } from './layout/navbar/navbar.component';
import { HomeComponent } from './pages/home/home.component';
import { AboutComponent } from './pages/about/about.component';
import { ServicesComponent } from './pages/services/services.component';
import { TeamComponent } from './pages/team/team.component';
import { PortfolioComponent } from './pages/portfolio/portfolio.component';
import { PricingComponent } from './pages/pricing/pricing.component';
import { ContactComponent } from './pages/contact/contact.component';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-root',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    NavbarComponent,
    HomeComponent,
    AboutComponent,
    ServicesComponent,
    TeamComponent,
    PortfolioComponent,
    PricingComponent,
    ContactComponent
  ],
  templateUrl: './app.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./app.component.css']
})
export class AppComponent {}

Make sure every symbol you put in imports is a standalone component (i.e., has standalone: true).

4) Ensure Angular version supports standalone components

Standalone components were stabilized in Angular v14+ and improved in v15+. Run:

bash
ng version

If your Angular version is older than 14, either upgrade or use the NgModule approach (Option 2 below).

Option 2 — Keep classic NgModule structure (if you don’t want standalone components)

If you prefer not to convert components to standalone, do not import them into AppComponent. Instead:

  1. Make sure each component is declared in AppModule:

ts
// src/app/app.module.ts
import { NgModule } from '@angular/core';
import { BrowserModule } from '@angular/platform-browser';

import { AppComponent } from './app.component';
import { NavbarComponent } from './layout/navbar/navbar.component';
import { HomeComponent } from './pages/home/home.component';
// ...other components

@NgModule({
  declarations: [
    AppComponent,
    NavbarComponent,
    HomeComponent,
    // ...other components
  ],
  imports: [
    BrowserModule,
    // other modules
  ],
  providers: [],
  bootstrap: [AppComponent]
})
export class AppModule {}

  1. In AppComponent do not use standalone: true or imports: [...]. Instead use plain class:

ts
// src/app/app.component.ts
import { Component } from '@angular/core';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-root',
  templateUrl: './app.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./app.component.css']
})
export class AppComponent {}

  1. Use components in app.component.html via their selectors <app-navbar></app-navbar> etc. No imports array used.

Quick ways to fix if you prefer CLI re-generation

If you haven't written much code yet, easiest is to regenerate components as standalone:

bash
ng generate component layout/navbar --standalone --skip-tests
ng generate component pages/home --standalone --skip-tests
ng generate component pages/about --standalone --skip-tests
# ...etc

That produces component files with standalone: true for you.

Checklist — before building again

  • Confirm each component imported into AppComponent has standalone: true.

  • For each standalone component, add imports: [CommonModule, ...otherStandaloneDeps] as needed.

  • If a component uses another standalone component in its template, include that component in its imports.

  • Ensure app.component.ts is standalone: true only if you want a standalone root (as in Option 1). If you use AppModule (classic approach), do not mark root standalone.

  • Run ng serve and watch compiler — if it complains about any specific component, open that component and add standalone: true + imports.

ChatGPT said:

This error means TypeScript/Angular can't find the ScrollService at the relative path you used. Fix is straightforward: create the service (or move it) and import it with the correct relative path.

I'll give you a minimal ScrollService, exactly where to place it, and the exact import line to use from your navbar folder.

1) Create the service file

Create this file at:

swift
src/app/core/services/scroll.service.ts

Contents (copy-paste):

ts
// src/app/core/services/scroll.service.ts
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class ScrollService {
  /**
   * Smooth-scroll to element with ID `id`.
   * Works with fixed navbar if CSS uses .ui-anchor scroll-margin-top.
   */
  scrollTo(id: string): void {
    if (!id) return;
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!el) return;
    el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
  }
}

Notes:

  • providedIn: 'root' registers the service globally — you don't need to add it to any providers array.

  • The service is intentionally compact and browser-native.

2) Use the correct import path in navbar.component.ts

If your navbar component lives at:

swift
src/app/layout/navbar/navbar.component.ts

then the correct relative import to the service above is:

Make sure this replaces any incorrect path you had like ../../services/scroll.service or ../services/scroll.service.

Full example header for navbar.component.ts:

import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';

  • File not created yet — create it at the path above.

  • Wrong folder depth in import — adjust ../../ accordingly:

    • From src/app/layout/navbar to src/app/core/services → ../../core/services/...

    • From src/app/pages/home to src/app/core/services → ../core/services/...

  • Typo in filename — ensure scroll.service.ts (lowercase).

  • Case-sensitivity on some OS/CI — exact match required.

Here’s the corrected contact.component.ts (replace your file with this):

ts
import { Component } from '@angular/core';
import { ReactiveFormsModule, FormBuilder, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { SectionHeaderComponent } from '../../shared/section-header/section-header.component';
import { QuoteService } from '../../core/services/quote.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-contact',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, SectionHeaderComponent],
  templateUrl: './contact.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./contact.component.css']
})
export class ContactComponent {
  loading = false;
  success = false;
  error = false;

  form: ReturnType<FormBuilder['group']>;

  constructor(private fb: FormBuilder, private quoteService: QuoteService) {
    this.form = this.fb.group({
      name: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.minLength(2)]],
      phone: ['', [Validators.required]],
      email: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.email]],
      location: ['', [Validators.required]],
      propertyType: ['House', [Validators.required]],
      cleaningType: ['Regular', [Validators.required]],
      preferredDate: [''],
      message: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.minLength(10)]],
    });
  }

  async submit() {
    this.success = false;
    this.error = false;

    if (this.form.invalid) {
      this.form.markAllAsTouched();
      return;
    }

    try {
      this.loading = true;
      await this.quoteService.submitQuote(this.form.getRawValue() as any);
      this.success = true;
      this.form.reset({
        propertyType: 'House',
        cleaningType: 'Regular'
      });
    } catch {
      this.error = true;
    } finally {
      this.loading = false;
    }
  }

  get waText(): string {
    return encodeURIComponent(
`Hi 👋 I’d like to book a cleaning / request a quote.
Location (Suburb & City): __________
Property type: House / Apartment / Flat
Bedrooms / Bathrooms: __ / __
Cleaning type: Regular / Deep / Move-in/out / Once-off
Preferred date & time: __________
Frequency: Weekly / Bi-weekly / Monthly
Extras: oven / fridge / windows / cupboards
Thank you!`
    );
  }
}

That will remove “fb used before initialization” immediately.

import { Component, inject } from '@angular/core';
import { ReactiveFormsModule, FormBuilder, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { SectionHeaderComponent } from '../../shared/section-header/section-header.component';

})
export class ContactComponent {

  private quoteService = inject(QuoteService);

  loading = false;
  success = false;
  error = false;

  form = this.fb.group({
    name: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.minLength(2)]],
    phone: ['', [Validators.required]],
    email: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.email]],
    location: ['', [Validators.required]],
    propertyType: ['House', [Validators.required]],
    cleaningType: ['Regular', [Validators.required]],
    preferredDate: [''],
    message: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.minLength(10)]],
  });

  async submit() {
    if (this.form.invalid) {
      this.form.markAllAsTouched();
      return;
    }

    try {
      this.loading = true;
      await this.quoteService.submitQuote(this.form.getRawValue() as any);
      this.success = true;
      this.form.reset({ propertyType: 'House', cleaningType: 'Regular' });
    } catch {
      this.error = true;

      this.loading = false;

}

You’ve got two concrete problems in that ContactComponent setup that cause template compilation to fail.

✅ Fix 1: Your stylesheet path/type is wrong

Your project was created with --style=css, so Angular expects .css, not .scss.

Right now you have:

src/app/pages/contact/contact.component.css

If you want SCSS, you must enable it project-wide or generate the component with scss.

✅ Fix 2 (most likely): you forgot to import CommonModule

Your contact template almost certainly uses *ngIf (success/error messages) and maybe other structural directives.
In standalone components, *ngIf needs CommonModule.

✅ Add CommonModule to imports

Update your component like this:

ts
import { Component } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { ReactiveFormsModule, FormBuilder, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { SectionHeaderComponent } from '../../shared/section-header/section-header.component';
import { QuoteService } from '../../core/services/quote.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-contact',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, ReactiveFormsModule, SectionHeaderComponent],
  templateUrl: './contact.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./contact.component.css']
})
export class ContactComponent {
  loading = false;
  success = false;
  error = false;

  form: ReturnType<FormBuilder['group']>;

  constructor(private fb: FormBuilder, private quoteService: QuoteService) {
    this.form = this.fb.group({
      name: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.minLength(2)]],
      phone: ['', [Validators.required]],
      email: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.email]],
      location: ['', [Validators.required]],
      propertyType: ['House', [Validators.required]],
      cleaningType: ['Regular', [Validators.required]],
      preferredDate: [''],
      message: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.minLength(10)]],
    });
  }

  async submit() {
    this.success = false;
    this.error = false;

    if (this.form.invalid) {
      this.form.markAllAsTouched();
      return;
    }

    try {
      this.loading = true;
      await this.quoteService.submitQuote(this.form.getRawValue() as any);
      this.success = true;
      this.form.reset({
        propertyType: 'House',
        cleaningType: 'Regular'
      });
    } catch {
      this.error = true;
    } finally {
      this.loading = false;
    }
  }

  get waText(): string {
    return encodeURIComponent(
`Hi 👋 I’d like to book a cleaning / request a quote.
Location (Suburb & City): __________
Property type: House / Apartment / Flat
Bedrooms / Bathrooms: __ / __
Cleaning type: Regular / Deep / Move-in/out / Once-off
Preferred date & time: __________
Frequency: Weekly / Bi-weekly / Monthly
Extras: oven / fridge / windows / cupboards
Thank you!`
    );
  }
}

Angular 17+ introduced block syntax using @.
Any raw @ in templates must now be escaped or interpolated.

  • Console shows 404 Not Found for ALL your images (hero-cleaning.png, regular.jpg, deep.jpg, etc.)

That usually means Angular is not serving src/assets at all, OR your URLs are being resolved relative to a different base path (SSR/SSG can make this stricter).

Here’s the fix that will solve it in almost every Angular 19 + SSR setup:

1) Use root-relative asset URLs everywhere

Change your hero image from:

html

to:

  • ✅ /assets/deep.jpg

  • ✅ /assets/moveout.jpg

  • ✅ /assets/supervisor.jpg

  • ✅ /assets/cleaner.jpg

  • ✅ /assets/1.jpg etc.

This avoids base-path issues and fixes 404s caused by relative resolving.

2) Confirm Angular is configured to copy/serve src/assets

Open angular.json and make sure your build options include src/assets like this:

json
"assets": [
  "src/favicon.ico",
  "src/assets"
]

If src/assets is missing → Angular will compile your app but will not serve images (result = 404 for all).

Found it ✅ — in your Angular 19 config you are only serving assets from public/, not from src/assets/. That’s why every /assets/... request is 404.

Right now you have:

json
"assets": [
  { "glob": "**/*", "input": "public" }
]

So Angular will only copy files from public/ into the build’s /assets/ (and dev server), and it will ignore src/assets completely.

✅ Solution (recommended): add src/assets back

Edit angular.json → projects → cleaning-services-website → architect → build → options → assets

Replace your current assets block with this:

json
"assets": [
  {
    "glob": "**/*",
    "input": "public"
  },
  {
    "glob": "**/*",
    "input": "src/assets",
    "output": "assets"
  }
],

✅ This makes Angular serve:

  • anything in public/ (as you already have)

  • AND anything in src/assets/ under /assets/...

background should make sure the image does not show corners
ChatGPT said:

Got it 👍
You want the hero background to blend seamlessly so the image corners never show against the dark gradient.

Right now the image is sitting inside a visible container, so its rectangular edges are noticeable.

Below are two clean, professional solutions.
👉 Solution A is the best / most common for hero sections.

✅ SOLUTION A (BEST): Let the background mask the image edges

1️⃣ Wrap the image in a masked container

Update your hero HTML (Home component):

html
<div class="hero-visual">
  <img
    src="/assets/hero-cleaning.png"
    alt="Professional cleaning illustration"
  />
</div>

2️⃣ Apply this CSS (THIS IS THE KEY FIX)

css
.hero {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  background:
    radial-gradient(1200px 500px at 70% 40%, rgba(0,194,255,0.15), transparent 60%),
    linear-gradient(180deg, #050b14, #0b1220);
}

/* Image container */
.hero-visual {
  position: relative;
  border-radius: 28px;            /* smooth rounded mask */
  overflow: hidden;               /* hides image corners */
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle at center,
    rgba(0,194,255,0.12),
    transparent 70%
  );
  box-shadow: 0 40px 120px rgba(0,0,0,.6);
}

/* Image itself */
.hero-visual img {
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  display: block;
  mask-image: radial-gradient(circle, black 65%, transparent 100%);
  -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(circle, black 65%, transparent 100%);
}

✅ Result

  • Image fades naturally into background

  • No visible sharp corners

  • Smooth, premium look

  • Perfect for dark tech-style heroes

✅ SOLUTION B (ALTERNATIVE): Use a glow overlay (simpler)

If you prefer no masking, use a glow overlay instead:

css
.hero-visual {
  position: relative;
  border-radius: 24px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.hero-visual::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: radial-gradient(
    ellipse at center,
    transparent 60%,
    #050b14 100%
  );
  pointer-events: none;
}

.hero-visual img {
  width: 100%;
  display: block;
}
